stem.en: In the 2010 experiment by J. Craig Venter and his team, which part of the final cell was made in a laboratory?

text.en: The whole cell, built from non-living chemicals.

feedback.en: The rest of the cell came from a living bacterium.

text.en: The cell membrane and the cytoplasm.

feedback.en: These were kept from the existing bacterium.

text.en: The DNA and all the ribosomes together.

feedback.en: Only one of these was made in the laboratory.
Yes. The DNA was synthetic, and the other parts came from a living cell.

explanation.en: The team made an exact copy of a bacterium's DNA and put it into a closely related bacterium whose own DNA had been removed. The other parts of the cell were not made by them.

hints.en: What did the team remove from the second bacterium, and what did they keep?
